bodyComparisonNormalization: CRLF to LF; trailing EOF whitespace removed

Repeated cursor stops after two calls and marks export incomplete

Full script creates UI; batch retains colliding short IDs, reports failures, and downloads partial archive

Cancelling picker creates no archive and restores controls
Raw JSON survives Markdown validation failure and is explicitly reported as JSON only
Images restricted to observed CDN schema, deduplicated, opt in, and reject HTML responses
